name: Userology
description_en:
Userology is a product in the UX design category. Its directory profile covers User Research, User Journeys, Usability Testing, Unmoderated Testing, Screen Activity Recording, Prototyping, For Websites, For Mobile.

Additional listed capabilities include Heatmaps. These areas should be evaluated against the tasks, permissions and data involved in the intended workflow.

Deployment is listed as Browser Based (Cloud). The listed organization sizes are All (Small, Medium, Large). API support is listed as NA. Support channels are listed as Online.

The directory's pricing snapshot states: Free Trial Available Offers Custom plan.. This is a dated third-party reference; current amounts, billing periods, trial conditions and regional availability require an official pricing check.
